  "rationale": "The set is strongly aligned with the exploratory intent: every column is an external, interpretable, categorical/boolean segmentation variable with well-separated, non-constant values that a human can group on and compare against goal_achievement. None merely restate the focus (goal_achievement itself is not duplicated) and none are opaque scores. Minor weaknesses: risk_or_dependency_indicator is heavily skewed (limiting contrast) and several columns overlap conceptually (scope vs. stakeholder_span vs. target_type), slightly diluting independent informativeness, hence a high but not maximal score."
